title: symphyotrichum patens var. gracile
intro: Symphyotrichum patens var. gracile, commonly known as the slender white aster, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the aster family (Asteraceae). The slender white aster is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic, making it beneficial for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of the slender white aster include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases and promote overall well-being.
